name: AWS Elastic Beanstalk
line: Deploy applications on AWS resources that Beanstalk manages for you.

free.text: $100 initial + up to $100 earned; up to six months

work.math: A t3.micro server for 730 hours ($7.592), plus about $0.64 for an 8 GB disk, plus an IPv4 address for 730 hours ($3.65). Assumes the CloudFront allowance is unused.
About $8.232 for compute and disk, plus $16.425 for load balancer (ALB) hours, plus $10.95 for 3 IPv4 addresses. Excludes load balancer capacity units (LCU) and rollout resources.
About $35.607 for the app base, plus $11.68 for RDS (the managed database), plus $2.30 for 20 GiB of storage. Excludes variable load balancer (ALB) use and backup excess.
